SELECT m.id AS message_id, m.session_id, m.round_no, m.question_text, m.image_file_ids, m.farm_id, f.name AS farm_name, m.user_id AS asker_id, u.name AS asker_name, m.batch_no, m.answer_type, m.rating, m.handle_status, m.asked_at, COALESCE(r.is_spot_check, 0) AS is_spot_check FROM t_ai_message m LEFT JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN t_ai_qa_review r ON r.message_id = m.id
ORDER BY m.asked_at DESC, m.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ai_message m LEFT JOIN t_ai_qa_review r ON r.message_id = m.id

SELECT m.id AS message_id, m.session_id, m.round_no, m.question_text, m.image_file_ids, m.farm_id, f.name AS farm_name, m.user_id AS asker_id, u.name AS asker_name, m.batch_no, m.answer_type, m.rating, m.handle_status, m.asked_at, COALESCE(r.is_spot_check, 0) AS is_spot_check FROM t_ai_message m LEFT JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN t_ai_qa_review r ON r.message_id = m.id
ORDER BY m.asked_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 50000

SELECT m.id AS message_id, m.session_id, m.round_no, m.question_text, m.image_file_ids, m.farm_id, f.name AS farm_name, m.user_id, u.name AS asker_name, (SELECT fm.role FROM t_farm_member fm WHERE fm.farm_id = m.farm_id AND fm.user_id = m.user_id AND fm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND fm.active_flag = 1 LIMIT 1) AS asker_role, m.batch_id, m.batch_no, s.batch_snapshot_json, m.context_course_id, m.context_course_title, m.context_knowledge_id, m.status, m.answer_type, m.answer_text, m.rating, m.handle_status, m.asked_at, m.answered_at, s.created_at AS session_started_at, s.round_count FROM t_ai_message m JOIN t_ai_session s ON s.id = m.session_id LEFT JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.id = #{messageId}
SELECT id AS message_id, round_no, asked_at, question_text, image_file_ids, status, answer_type, answer_text, rating, rated_at FROM t_ai_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY round_no

SELECT message_id, seq_no, knowledge_id, knowledge_version_no, para_key, source_type, icon_type, title_snapshot, category_name_snapshot FROM t_ai_citation WHERE message_id IN #{id} ORDER BY message_id, seq_no

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qa_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m.user_id) AS asker_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.rating IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rated_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.rating = 'USEFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS useful_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.rating = 'USELESS' AND m.handle_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_useless_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.answer_type = 'NO_BASIS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_basis_count, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.rating IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.rating = 'USEFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN m.rating IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 4) END AS useful_rate FROM t_ai_message m WHERE m.asked_at >= #{from} AND m.asked_at < #{to}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_session s SET s.has_correction = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ai_correction c WHERE c.session_id = s.id AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED'), s.updated_at = NOW() WHERE s.id = #{sessionId}
